title: Diff Table
summary: Marks the cells that actually differ in a comparison table and shows blanks as "Not stated", so people don't pick the wrong plan.
description: Marks cells that actually differ (ignoring case, spacing and 10 GB vs 10GB), offers "Show only differences" with a count of hidden identical rows, and shows blank cells as "Not stated", never a dash that reads as "No".
catches: Real differences hidden among identical rows
Formatting-only differences that aren't real (case, spaces, units spacing)
Blank cells that would be read as "No"
limits: Normalisation is simple; values that mean the same in different words still show as different
Rows with blank cells stay visible even when showing only differences
a11y: The filter is a role="switch" with aria-checked
Yes/No cells use text plus icons; differing cells say so in text
stops: Picked the wrong plan from a comparison
